subject: Re: Platform consolidation options — support + success tooling roadmap
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Platform consolidation options — support + success tooling roadmap

Team —

Quick summary: our combined spend and fragmentation across Intercom (messaging + help center), Gainsight (CS platform), and Zendesk (legacy support) is creeping up and making ops expensive. I pulled Q1 spend and usage (attached) and I think we should decide whether we: 1) consolidate on Intercom + Gainsight, 2) consolidate on Zendesk + Gainsight, or 3) pursue a staged migration (pilot then full cutover).

Asks:
- Ben: can you get updated enterprise quotes (including attachment/transfer fees and data migration estimates) from Intercom and Zendesk this week?
- Stephanie: highlight any legal/contract termination constraints for existing agreements (notice periods, auto-renewals, data retention clauses).
- Monica: rough budget guardrails for a 6–12 month migration/pilot (capex vs opex).

I've attached the spend workbook with usage slices. Goal: pick a path and vendor by next Friday so we can start pilots in May.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: support_tools_spend_q1_q2_2026-2027.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform consolidation options — support + success tooling roadmap

Lauren —

Thanks for the deck. I reached out to Intercom and Zendesk; Intercom (Sarah) said she can turn around an enterprise quote and migration estimate by Friday, and Zendesk asked for a short intake form — I sent them our usage export. I also pinged Gainsight (Adam) to confirm integration/connector complexity (they called out a 4–6 week implementation for full health scoring + playbooks if we go heavy).

Preliminary points from vendor intake:
- Intercom: attractive for inbox + product messaging; carries migration effort for historical tickets and knowledge base. They have a migration tool but will charge for large exports.
- Zendesk: better built-in routing and queue controls; migration of bot flows and custom macros will be manual in places.
- Gainsight: has packaged connectors but pricing stair-steps by number of tracked accounts/events.

I'll stitch vendor responses into a single comparison matrix and share version 1 in the Drive link.

Ben
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform consolidation options — legal constraints and security checklist

Lauren / team —

Quick legal/security notes after scanning our current vendor contracts:
- Intercom: auto-renews annually with 60-day notice to opt-out. There is a clause around data transfer that requires us to verify transfer method; enterprise customers can request a data export addendum.
- Zendesk: also auto-renews but has a 90-day cancellation window for enterprise agreements. Some older contracts include a clause limiting third-party data processors; we'll need to confirm with GDPR/DPAs for EU data.
- Gainsight: current agreement is a 12-month term with 30-day renewal notice. SOWs for implementation are typically separate and editable.

Security evidence requests we'll need from any vendor we select: SOC 2 Type II, pen test reports (last 12 months), data retention policies, and a clear list of subprocessors. If we plan a pilot in May, we should ask vendors for these documents during the quote stage.

I've uploaded a short checklist and a draft SOW template for the implementation work.

Attachment: gainsight_sow_draft.docx

- Stephanie
Senior Counsel, Legal Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@intercom.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Intercom enterprise estimate for Redwood — initial quote attached

Hi Lauren / Ben —

Great speaking with Ben earlier. Attached is an initial enterprise quote and migration outline. Highlights:
- Total first-year cost (platform + migration services): $145,000 (estimate)
- Migration includes ticket export, basic KB import, and one week on-site migration support (if needed).
- SOC 2 Type II + pen test reports available on request (I attached redacted SOC summary in the packet).

Notes: we recommend a phased migration — start with the product messaging and a limited ticket pilot (top 3 queues) to validate routing and KB parity. If Redwood wants Gainsight integration, we can scope an event stream connector; pricing is additive.

Attachment: intercom_enterprise_quote_Mar2027.pdf

Best,
Sarah Lopez
Account Exec, Intercom
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@intercom.com>, Adam Frye <adam.frye@gainsight.com>, sales@zendesk.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform consolidation options — next steps and selection criteria

Thanks all —

Appreciate the quick responses. We're narrowing requirements to three pillars: cost (TCO over 24 months), security/compliance fit, and implementation risk (time + manual lift). From a product ops perspective we also weight native inbox routing and KB parity higher.

Immediate ask for vendors: final, itemized 24-month TCO (include migration, licensing, and typical professional services), SOC 2 Type II evidence, and a high-level migration checklist by Wed EOD (24 Mar). We'll review and make a go/no-go decision for a May pilot by Fri 26 Mar.

Ben/Monica: once we have the three vendor packets, please add a recommended path and a draft PO line for numbers.

Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C-support-tooling-roadmap (comparison matrix V1)

Lauren

After reviewing preliminary vendor packets (Intercom PDF + Gainsight SOW draft + Zendesk intake), finance will greenlight a $60k pilot budget for a targeted migration (top 3 queues + KB parity) provided vendors deliver SOC 2 Type II and a clear rollback plan. If the combined 24-month TCO for our preferred path exceeds $300k, we will require a second-level approval from FP&A.

Next steps:
- Ben: consolidate vendor final numbers into the matrix by Thu EOD and flag any add-ons.
- Stephanie: confirm required contract termination language and required DPA addenda for the pilot.
- Lauren: if we hit the pilot budget, I'll draft a PO and routing for approvals.

Thanks — Monica
